newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude shrinks in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude shrinks in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude shrank in late U.S. paper trading on Friday at the expiry of the IPE July contract, traders said.
Two full boats of July Brent changed hands at $17.46 and $17.47 a barrel, down from a close of $17.70 on the IPE.
Eight partial cargoes of August Brent changed hands between $17.69 and $17.74 a barrel, down from the IPE close of $17.78 a barrel.
July/August traded twice at minus 28 cents and minus 28.5 cents a barrel.
